newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London up in holiday mood.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London up in holiday mood.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were led higher by strength from the FTSE and Dow on Friday with gains in HSBC Holdings the main feature of a market subdued by the Chinese New Year holiday, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference index ended 111.01 points higher at 13,771.51 points. The Hong Kong bourse was closed for a holiday.
Shares in HSBC rose seven Hong Kong dollars, traders said, before settling at HK$ 190.95, up HK$5.2.
Traders said the trading session had been curtailed and market sentiment was hard to judge with so little activity.
"Had we been open all day we would have been up 200 points, I'm sure," one trader said. "But all we can do is look at other markets and wait until Monday."
